description: The popup panel. It reads the in-memory snapshot, changes its own settings and asks for a window that fits its content through this application's own commands, listens for one event (core:default already allows that), and hides itself on Esc; it opens no dialogs, runs no shell commands and reaches no network. Commands the application defines itself need no entry here — WP4's set is get_ui_state, set_theme, dismiss_hint, set_panel_height, open_panel and quit — so the list stays the core defaults plus the one window permission the panel uses to hide itself. Resizing goes through set_panel_height rather than core:window:allow-set-size, so the webview cannot resize its window except by asking, and the Rust side clamps what it asks for. Every permission beyond that is listed with the reason it is needed.
